title: Application and Approval Terms Across the Home Comfort Financing Plans
content:
Home Comfort Financing loans are originated by Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A., the servicing partner on all six plans, and serviced by Harbison. The application, approval and account-holding terms below are identical on every plan; the table states them once for all six.

| Term | 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest | 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment | 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment | 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate | 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate | 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the decision during which an approval can fund | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Calendar days after a decline before the same customer may apply again | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Approval may be moved to another plan before funding | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Event that funds the loan | installation completed | installation completed | installation completed | installation completed | installation completed | installation completed |
| Co-applicant may join the application | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Soft prequalification (no hard credit inquiry) offered | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Accounts in approved, active or delinquent status one customer may hold at once | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Bank that originates the loans Harbison services | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. | Buckeye Valley Bank, N.A. |

## Notes on the terms

- **Approval window — 90 calendar days.** An approval on any plan can fund during the 90 calendar days after its credit decision.
- **Reapplication wait — 30 calendar days.** The wait after a decline is the same 30 calendar days whichever plan was applied for.
- **Funding event.** On every plan the loan funds when the installation is completed.
- **Holding limit — 2 accounts.** The count covers accounts in approved, active or delinquent status.
